BiblicalUsage: Chileab is David's second son, named once in the list of his sons born in Hebron. 2 Samuel 3:3 calls him the son of Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite, between Amnon and Absalom.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Chileab's single verse is enough: he is the son of the wise woman who kept David from bloodguilt, and his name stands in the line that led to the throne.
